source_integrity.details: No real source-integrity checker exists yet (Member 2's component) -- 'passed: true' is asserted by construction (plain Maven, no instrumentation involved), not independently checked.

limitations: victim_alone (and reproduction, identical since reduced_sequence is empty) is a REAL measured count: od-fixture's N2 case was actually run alone 20 times via plain Maven on 2026-10-09 (eval/tools/run_real_reps.sh) -- result was 12 failures / 20 runs, not a round or hand-picked number. See docs/evidence-m3.md and eval/benchmark/logs/N2.json.

N2 negative control: this victim fails INTERMITTENTLY even in isolation (driven by System.nanoTime() parity, unrelated to any shared static field or system property). Any isolation run that reproduces the reference signature at all -- even 12/20, not just a deterministic 20/20 like N1 -- is enough to trigger VICTIM_FAILS_ALONE before reproduction counting is ever consulted. This is the real-data confirmation of a decision made during Phase 3 when this case's ground truth was corrected from an earlier NOT_REPRODUCED guess (see fixtures/od-fixture/ground_truth.json).
